<!--- Provide a `label` and the required `objectName` and `property` --->
#telField(label="Phone Number", objectName="contact", property="phone")#

<!--- Add a CSS class and a placeholder for formatting guidance --->
#telField(label="Mobile", objectName="user", property="mobile", class="tel-input", placeholder="+1-555-000-0000")#

<!--- Render telephone fields for each phone number in a nested association --->
<fieldset>
	<legend>Phone Numbers</legend>
	<cfloop from="1" to="#ArrayLen(contact.phoneNumbers)#" index="i">
		#telField(label="Phone ##i#", objectName="contact", association="phoneNumbers", position=i, property="number")#
	</cfloop>
</fieldset>
